claims.text: tofu plan reads the current configuration and the remote objects OpenTofu manages, compares them and proposes the actions needed to make the objects match the configuration, without carrying out any of them; it creates, changes and deletes no real object.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs: CLI > Commands > tofu plan ("does not actually carry out the proposed changes")

claims.text: Each object in a plan opens with a '# <address> ...' header: 'will be created' (lines marked +), 'will be updated in-place' (marked ~, object kept), 'must be replaced', 'will be destroyed'.
claims.source_hint: real runs, OpenTofu 1.10.10, outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/: tofu-first-cluster.txt l.27-33 (legend '+ create', 'will be created'); tofu-drift.txt l.5-6; tofu-plan-apply.txt l.7; tofu-state.txt l.8

claims.text: A replacement is planned when the provider cannot change an attribute of an existing object in place; the plan marks the object 'must be replaced' and the attribute line with '# forces replacement'; by default the old object is destroyed before the new one is created.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs: Language > Resources > Behavior (replace; lifecycle create_before_destroy default false); examples/don-hang outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/tofu-plan-apply.txt lines 7-8

claims.text: After the objects, the plan prints a summary line of the form 'Plan: N to add, N to change, N to destroy.'; a replacement counts as one to add and one to destroy (here 1 to add, 0 to change, 1 to destroy).
In tehcyx/kind 0.11.0, changing node_image of an existing kind_cluster forces replacement of the cluster (plan: kind_cluster.this must be replaced, node_image ... # forces replacement).
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/tofu-plan-apply.txt lines 6-9; DECISIONS.md mục 357 (kiểm khả thi: đổi node_image → forces replacement)

claims.text: Replacing the kind cluster destroys it and creates a new, empty cluster, so every object that ran in the old cluster (such as Pods) is lost.
claims.source_hint: search.opentofu.org tehcyx/kind 0.11.0 kind_cluster (destroy deletes the kind cluster); kind docs Quick Start (deleting a cluster)

claims.text: tofu apply without a saved plan file creates a new execution plan, prints it, then 'Do you want to perform these actions?' followed by "Only 'yes' will be accepted to approve.", and acts only after approval.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs: CLI > Commands > tofu apply (Automatic Plan Mode); examples/don-hang outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/tofu-first-cluster.txt lines 24-64

claims.text: tofu plan -out=FILE writes the plan to a file; tofu apply FILE performs exactly the actions in that saved plan without asking for approval and without printing the plan again.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs: CLI > Commands > tofu plan (-out) and tofu apply (Saved Plan Mode); examples/don-hang outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/tofu-plan-apply.txt lines 11-20

claims.text: When the remote objects already match the configuration, plan prints 'No changes. Your infrastructure matches the configuration.' and tofu apply without a file finishes ('Apply complete! Resources: 0 added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed.') without the 'Do you want to perform these actions?' prompt.

The full plan for kind_cluster.this prints every attribute, the cluster's credentials included; tofu-plan-apply.sh keeps only '  # ' lines, 'forces replacement' lines and the 'Plan:' line, so the line of symbols opening the resource is not shown.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang scripts/devops/tofu-plan-apply.sh at stage-3 lines 17-20; outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/tofu-first-cluster.txt lines 33-44 (attribute list)

claims.text: tofu-plan-apply.sh edits node_image on line 21 of main.tf with perl, shows the change with diff, and restores the original main.tf afterwards (mv, and a trap on EXIT); it runs after tofu-first-cluster.sh, which created donhang-iac.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang scripts/devops/tofu-plan-apply.sh at stage-3 lines 1-22; outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/tofu-plan-apply.txt lines 1-4

claims.text: Đơn Hàng's CI iac job runs only tofu fmt -check, init and validate, and never tofu plan or tofu apply.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang .github/workflows/ci.yml at stage-3, job iac; DECISIONS.md mục 291 (2)

claims.text: kind runs each node as a Docker container; kind get clusters lists cluster names; docker ps --filter name=donhang-iac lists containers whose name contains donhang-iac, STATUS showing uptime ('Up 20 minutes'); a replaced cluster is a new container.
claims.source_hint: docs.docker.com: docker container ls (--filter name, STATUS); kind Quick Start (nodes are Docker containers; kind get clusters); scripts/k8s/cluster-up.sh l.3, l.10 at stage-3

claims.text: When the files or real objects may have changed since you read a plan, read the plan tofu apply prints before typing yes, or save a plan with -out, read it, and apply that file.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs: CLI > tofu apply (Saved Plan Mode); Core workflow (review the plan before applying)

claims.text: A Kubernetes rolling update replaces a Deployment's Pods a few at a time while the app keeps serving; 'must be replaced' on kind_cluster replaces the whole cluster at once.
cluster-up.sh creates the cluster donhang from deploy/k8s/kind-config.yaml only when kind get clusters does not list it, so changing the image in that file does nothing to an existing cluster.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang scripts/k8s/cluster-up.sh at stage-3 lines 8-17; deploy/k8s/kind-config.yaml (image lines)
